# IDN Times

> > IDN Times is Indonesia's leading digital media platform covering sports, lifestyle, Islamic content, and education with comprehensive coverage of soccer leagues, local events, and Indonesian culture.

IDN Times delivers news and articles across multiple verticals including international and domestic soccer (Liga Champions, Premier League, Serie A), Indonesian sports events (Malang Half Marathon), Islamic guidance (Ramadan, Zakat Fitrah, Lebaran), lifestyle trends, and educational resources. The platform serves Indonesian audiences with locally relevant content while covering global sports personalities like Liverpool, Real Madrid, and Atalanta.

## Key Topics

- Liga Champions (Champions League)
- Liverpool FC
- Real Madrid
- Serie A
- Premier League
- Ramadan & Islamic practices
- Lebaran (Idul Fitri)
- Indonesian sports events
- Malang Half Marathon 2026
- Sport tourism
- KIP Kuliah scholarship
- Mudik (homecoming tradition)
- Indonesian national team
- Badminton (All England)
- FIFA World Cup 2026
